anomalies.description: A large truck loses control, veers right, and overturns onto its side on the roadside, emitting smoke/dust during the rollover.

A white taxi (Yandex.Taxi) cuts sharply across the lane from left to right in front of the camera vehicle, making contact or near-contact; the taxi’s front passenger side appears to strike or graze the camera vehicle’s front right side at ~26.0s, causing visible lateral displacement and dust/debris.

A black sedan in the right lane suddenly swerves left, colliding with a red car in the adjacent lane; the black car rotates approximately 90 degrees and comes to rest横跨 two lanes, indicating a side-impact collision.

A vehicle on the right side of the road suddenly veers left and collides with the vehicle ahead (or possibly the central barrier), resulting in an immediate, intense flash of fire and debris at impact.; Immediately following the explosion, a vehicle ahead (likely the source) is seen with bright, distorted red taillights and appears to be veering or losing control; by f3–f4, it is clearly off its lane and possibly involved in a collision or post-impact skid. The sequence suggests a crash triggered by or coinciding with the explosion.

A sudden, bright orange fireball erupts following the collision, consistent with a fuel tank ignition or rapid combustion event; the intensity and rapid expansion indicate an explosive ignition rather than sustained burning.
A white car parked on a dirt road is struck by a falling utility pole or cable, causing visible impact and debris; the pole appears to snap and whip across the scene, hitting the vehicle.
